description.value: A dense silicate world in the outer tail, catalogued three times under three different codes before anybody noticed that the three entries were the same planet. The surface is old cratered basalt under a thin frost cover, and a shallow endolithic zone lives in the fracture porosity where residual heat still reaches. The current survey has been open since 2281 and has produced two papers and one very long dispute about the name.

Um mundo silicatado denso na cauda exterior, catalogado três vezes sob três códigos diferentes antes de alguém reparar que as três entradas eram o mesmo planeta. A superfície é basalto antigo cheio de crateras sob uma fina camada de geada, e uma zona endolítica pouco profunda vive na porosidade das fraturas, até onde ainda chega o calor residual. O levantamento atual está aberto desde 2281 e produziu dois artigos e uma disputa muito longa a respeito do nome.

atmosphere.value: 0.02 bar of nitrogen with argon and a carbon dioxide frost cycle. Thin enough that a suit is mandatory and thick enough to raise dust devils, which were for a decade the single most photographed fact about the place.

notes.value: The three codes were issued in 2281, 2283 and 2286 by three offices that were all, at the time, waiting for each other's data. The name is the joke the survey made about it, and it has now outlasted the people who made it.
